issues.competing_evidence: Historical UX UMa/nova-like literature; Kato+21 low-amplitude Z Cam-type behavior/standstills; Kára+23 RW Sex-class disc/outflow interpretation.
issues.why_it_matters: A single subtype could hide distinct photometric and spectroscopic phenomenology and distort cross-population comparisons.
issues.needed_action: Choose a community-facing display convention. Current audit keeps non-magnetic CV broad class and stores dated labels separately; no evolutionary sequence is asserted.

issues.competing_evidence: Beuermann & Thomas/Linnell Table 5: 7.9±1.0e-9 Msun yr-1; Linnell Table 9 final FUSE/STIS model: 5.0±1.0e-9; Hewitt illustrative SED curve uses 7e-9 and is not fitted.
issues.why_it_matters: These values depend on different model setups/epochs and must not be averaged or treated as direct measurements.
issues.needed_action: Keep alternatives separate. If a single value is needed for comparison, specify the model/epoch and whether a model-derived rate is acceptable.

issues.competing_evidence: Long+94 expects 50,000–75,000 K by analogy but fits the HUT continuum with a disc-only model; Linnell+07 adopts 60,000±10,000 K and derives the WD radius from a 60,000 K carbon-WD model.
issues.why_it_matters: Treating an adopted model temperature as a direct measurement would bias WD-temperature comparisons.
issues.needed_action: Decide whether the wide-table WD Teff field should retain an explicitly flagged model value or remain blank with the result only in the ledger.

issues.competing_evidence: 4XMM-DR11 native 0.2–12 keV flux (4.16888±0.02546)e-12; Ridder+23 converted 1–10 and 0.1–10 keV values (2.2±0.2 and 4.2±0.4)e-12 with generic band conversion/error floor; Rodriguez+25 eRASS1 0.2–2.3 keV flux 2.895±0.118e-12. Different surveys/epochs; Ridder IX Vel absorption convention unspecified.
issues.why_it_matters: These are not same-band/same-state fluxes; absorption convention changes luminosity interpretation.
issues.needed_action: Keep native and converted products separate. For a community summary, decide which band/convention to display or verify exact Ridder input/absorption pathway.

issues.parameter: approximately 25 s flickering versus WD spin
issues.competing_evidence: Beuermann & Thomas+90 cites Warner et al. (1985) for low-amplitude non-constant ~25 s optical flickering; original timing paper not retrieved, and checked sources do not establish a stable WD spin clock.
issues.why_it_matters: Mislabeling flickering as spin would create a false WD clock in comparisons with pulsars or magnetic CVs.
issues.needed_action: If a spin claim is needed, inspect Warner et al. (1985) original timing analysis; keep current spin field blank.

issues.competing_evidence: RUWE=0.975865 and duplicated_source=false are nominal, but astrometric excess noise=0.19163206 mas with significance 46.875946. Exact counterpart remains supported by Gaia/SIMBAD and multiple X-ray identities.
issues.why_it_matters: The very small formal parallax uncertainty and normal RUWE may understate astrometric systematics in an unresolved interacting binary.
issues.needed_action: Before precision parallax interpretation, check Gaia astrometric caveats and later independent astrometry; do not change the secure counterpart on this flag alone.
